106
FM news channels
†*361. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that his Ministry
has banned broadcast of news on the private
FM channels;
(b) whether it is also a fact that despite
the ban private FM channels are explaining
the news in their own way and broadcasting
them; and
(c) if so, Government’s reaction in this
regard?
Disease prone areas
†*362. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have identified
the areas prone to deadly diseases like
malaria, encephalitis and dengue;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action plan/measures taken so far
to contain the diseases?
WIN2\SESSION\2452RS 106
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Economic cooperation between India
and France
*363. SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the economic
cooperation between India and France
is not the most satisfactory aspect of
the relationship between the two
countries and is not commensurate with
the potential;
(b) if so, whether the French
Ambassador in India has suggested
that there should be more investment
by the French companies in India and
vice-versa;
(c) whether the trade between the two
countries is also not up to potential; and
(d) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to improve the Indo-French trade
ties and also the investment?

107
WIN2\SESSION\2452RS 107
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Calorie content of food
*364. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of food required for a
minor and an adult to maintain sound health
in terms of calories;
(b) the average food availability in the
country for different age groups in terms of
calories, State-wise:
(c) the State with the lowest and highest
average; and
(d) the status of average calories
availability in the country when compared
with the international scale?
Allotment of land to institutions
†*365. SHRI LAJPAT RAI: Will the
Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT
AND POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the CBI has
been entrusted with the task to investigate
into the allotment of land by DDA to 291
institutions during the last year;
(b) if so, what necessiated this
investigation;
(c) whether the probe is yet to be
completed by the CBI; and
(d) if so, by when the probe is likely to
be completed?
Amendment in Foreign Trade
(Development and Regulation)
Act, 1992
*366. SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
 Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
amend the Foreign Trade (Development  and
Regulation) Act, 1992 with a view to restrict
export of dual technologies;
(b) if so, whether it also seeks to regulate
trade between special economic zones and
the rest of the country;
(c) whether the proposal initiated by his
Ministry has been approved; and
(d) if so, by when action on this proposal
is likely to be taken?
Third Master Plan for Delhi
*367. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN:
SHRI MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA:
 Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have recently
issued new guidelines for the Third Master
Plan for Delhi - 2021;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government are aware of
the response of the experts and specialists
in the field, town planners, representatives
of trade and industry, etc. to the proposed
guidelines; and
(d) if so, Government's reaction thereto?
NGOs for implementation of
programmes

Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) the list indicating location of NGOs
being shortlisted for implementation of the
schemes of his Ministry in Assam showing

WIN2\SESSION\2454RS 590
Export of the products of
DWCRA self-help groups
2698. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any initiative on the
part of Government to export products of
DWCRA self-help groups with a common
brand name with assistance from UNO;
(b) if so, the steps taken, so far;
(c) if not, the steps Government intend
to take to make the self-help group
movement more sustainable and to
supplement efforts of the States like Andhra
Pradesh where DWCRA is a success story;
(d) whether there is any proposal to
rope in MNCs to market the DWCRA
products; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Price Stabilisation Fund for
plantation sector
2699. SHRI R.P. GOENKA:
SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a proposal
has been formulat ed to seek funds from
the World Bank and other multilateral
agencies to enhance the Price Stabilisation
Fund (PSF) created for the plantation
sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof, with its
present status; and
(c) the details of other initiatives being
taken, if any, to provide relief to the
plantation sector?
Floriculture export
2700. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY:
SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether floriculture exports from
the country have gone up during the last
two years;
(b) if so, the States exporting more
floriculture products; and
(c) the measures proposed to encourage
the floriculturists to grow more flowers to
increase trade further?

591
WIN2\SESSION\2454RS 591
Screening Committee for deputation
to Singapore
2701. SHRI BALKAVI BAIRAGI:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Screening
Committee for deputation to Singapore
for participation in Second Round of
Negotiations on the Indo-Singapore
Comprehensive Economic Cooperation
Agreement (CECA) held on the 1st to
3rd July, 2003 has taken a number of
decisions;
(b) if so, the details of the subjects
discussed in the above meeting and the
delegations participated therein;
(c) the decisions taken so far by CECA
on various issues; and
(d) how many meetings have been held
so far, date-wise and  venue-wise and when
the next meeting has been fixed with the
details of the subjects, Ministry-wise, likely
to be included in CECA?
Farm export subsidies
2702. DR. A.R. KIDWAI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether European Union has stuck
to its stand that the farm export subsidies
can not be reduced and to push forward
proposals for the negotiations on the
possible multilateral agreements on
investment;
(b) if so, whether recently at Nyon near
Geneva, a meeting was held with the
developing countries on agriculture and the
issues of special products, special safeguard
measures and subsidies discussed;
(c) whether Government have decided
to accord top priority to increase market
access for products of dairy, cereals,
sugar, meat, poultry, fruits and
vegetables; and
(d) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to see that WTO recommendations
are fully met?
FDI Cap in various sectors
2703. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are thinking of increasing FDI Cap in
telecom, aviation, natural gas and liquified
natural gas sectors;
(b) whether Government are also
thinking of increasing FDI to 100 per cent
in scientific and technical magazines,
periodicals and journals; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Growth of exports
2704. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MISS MABEL REBELLO:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have fixed a target of 12 per cent growth
in exports during the current fiscal year;
(b) if so, the details of the projections of
rise in different sectors;
(c) whether this target has been worked
out in consultation with the Export Promotion
Councils; and
(d) the kind of incentives that
Government, grant to the companies to boost
the exports?
